use_syslog.description: Whether to use syslog for logging (1) or stderr/file (0).

smc_socket_path.description: Path to the SMC socket for management communication.

synce_device_name.description: Name of the logical SyncE device section.

network_option.description: Network option mode (1 or 2) as defined in T-REC-G.8264.

recover_time.description: Seconds to recover from QL-failed state (Range: 10-720).

clock_id.description: Clock id of the dpll device in the system.

module_name.description: Kernel module name which handles the dpll device.

dnu_prio.description: Device priority value for input pins marked as DNU.

synce_port_name_1.description: Name of the first SyncE port section.

tx_heartbeat_msec_1.description: TX heartbeat resolution in msec for the first port.

rx_heartbeat_msec_1.description: RX heartbeat resolution in msec for the first port.

synce_port_name_2.description: Name of the second SyncE port section.

synce_ext_source_name_1.description: Name of the first external clock source.

synce_ext_source_input_ql_1.description: Input Quality Level (QL) for the first external source.

synce_ext_source_input_ext_ql_1.description: Input Extended QL for the first external source.

synce_ext_source_board_label_1.description: Board label for the first external source.

synce_ext_source_internal_prio_1.description: Internal priority for the first external source.

synce_ext_source_name_2.description: Name of the second external clock source.

synce_ext_source_input_ql_2.description: Input Quality Level (QL) for the second external source.

synce_ext_source_input_ext_ql_2.description: Input Extended QL for the second external source.

synce_ext_source_board_label_2.description: Board label for the second external source.

synce_ext_source_internal_prio_2.description: Internal priority for the second external source.
